title: Seneye Light PAR Drift by Tank
dataSources: Apex controller readings (`apex:reading`), Seneye measurements (`seneye:reading`), reptile thermostat events (`reptilethermostat:event`), and misting-system cycles (`mister:cycle`).
app: Aquarium and terrarium telemetry from Neptune Apex, Seneye, reptile thermostats, and misting systems sent to Splunk HEC via controller APIs, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=seneye:reading
| search par_delta_pct=*
| stats avg(par_delta_pct) as avg_par_delta_pct max(par_delta_pct) as max_par_delta_pct by tank_name
| sort 0 - avg_par_delta_pct
value: PAR drift helps you notice aging bulbs, dirty covers, or programming changes before corals or plants do.
implementation: Send PAR drift events to `index=personal` and keep `tank_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of PAR drift by tanks.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which tankss stand out most for PAR drift.
